preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the leftChild and rightChild arrays is equal to the number of nodes.
Each child index is either -1 or a valid node index within the range of 0 to n - 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == True if and only if all the given nodes form exactly one valid binary tree
postconditions.description: The function returns True if the nodes form a valid binary tree, and False otherwise.
